milestones.name: FY26, M06 | Municipalities | 250th Anniversary Final Call
milestones.description:
## Summary

Last-call urgency send for the 250th Anniversary offer to US municipalities. Targets M3 non-engagers + net-new municipalities never on the M3 list, reframed around the calendar-forced "build window closes end of June" urgency angle.

**Lead angle:** Last realistic build window for July 4 250th custom illuminated installations — anything scoped in July ships too late.

**Brand:** Brite Labs

---

## ICP & targeting

* **Tier:** Enterprise — cities >25k pop with active July 4 / civic programming budgets, dedicated parks-and-rec or special-events staff
* **DM titles:** Director of Parks and Recreation, Director of Cultural Affairs, Special Events Coordinator, Director of Tourism, Downtown Development Director, City Manager, Public Art Coordinator, DDA Executive Director
* **Target volume per ESP:** Google 800 / Microsoft 1,200 / SMTP 800 (\~2,800 prospects)

## Exclusion logic

* Suppress ALL M3 Municipalities 250th recipients who opened/clicked/replied
* Target only (a) M3 non-engagers where 90+ days have passed, AND (b) net-new municipalities sourced via [SAM.gov](<http://SAM.gov>) + state municipal league directories not in original M3 list
* Cross-workspace EB suppression mandatory (workspace 55 + workspace 13)

## 2-cycle rule justification

90 days from M3 < 180-day floor. Calendar forces it — 250th cannot ship after July 4. M3 non-engagers didn't consume the offer; net-new munis weren't on M3 list.

---

## History

* M3 Municipalities America 250 — 706 leads, 51 replies, 16 bounced, 100% complete. M6 final-call targets non-engagers + net-new only.

---

*Draft milestone proposed via planning session 2026-05-15. Review before activating.*

**Lead angle:** Custom illuminated installations sized for vineyard rows + biergartens that extend evening events and drive Instagram-shareable moments → wine-club sign-ups.

**Brand:** Brite Labs

---

## ICP & targeting

* **Tier:** Affluent/luxury — estate wineries >$10M revenue with on-premise wedding/event venues, craft breweries with taprooms + outdoor programming + active event calendars
* **DM titles:** Director of Hospitality, Events Manager, Director of Marketing, Tasting Room Manager, Director of Wine Club, GM, Director of Experiences
* **Target volume per ESP:** Google 1,100 / Microsoft 1,700 / SMTP 1,100 (\~3,900 prospects)

## Exclusion logic

* Net-new vertical for FY26 — no prior sends to suppress
* Standard cross-workspace EB suppression + SF Lead suppression
* Build via Spider.cloud crawl of state wine/brewery association directories (Napa Valley Vintners, CA Brewers Guild, Oregon Wine Board, NY Wine, WA Wine)

---

## TAM signal

* True US TAM: \~20,500 venues (11k wineries with tasting rooms + 9.5k craft breweries with taprooms)

* Realistic clean addressable: 3,000-4,000 contacts

milestones.name: FY26, M07 | Universities | Holiday Lighting

* **Tier:** Enterprise — R1/R2 + top-100 endowment privates + flagship state universities with >$500M endowments
* **DM titles:** VP/AVP Facilities, Director of Grounds, Director of Auxiliary Services, Senior Director of Campus Operations, VP Alumni Relations, Director of Advancement Events, Campus Architect
* **Target volume per ESP:** Google 400 / Microsoft 200 / SMTP 200 (\~800 prospects M7)

## Exclusion logic

* M2 Colleges & Universities was generic — NOT Holiday Lighting offer
* Cross-workspace EB suppression for any contact that received M2
* 2-cycle rule satisfied: M7 = cycle 2 with materially different offer + different buyer persona (facilities vs academic)

---

## TAM signal

* True US TAM: \~480 institutions matching luxury tier
* Realistic clean addressable: \~1,150-1,200 verified facilities/advancement contacts

---

## History
